attacker_pocs.name: short_disparity_crop
attacker_pocs.why: A custom image built through the public component API has a full-size filter-array component and a shorter disparity component. The shipped geometry check accepts the short disparity plane, so public crop reads beyond its allocation. The upstream fix requires disparity height to equal the image height and rejects the crop.

role_a_rationale: The commit adds expected-size cases for filter-array and depth channels, while the disparity case permits a height below the image height. Normal full-size planes behave as in the upstream fix. A short disparity plane passes this incomplete validation and reaches an out-of-bounds read in crop; the upstream fix rejects it. The source change is confined to the existing plane-geometry switch. CTest reported zero failures among 25 tests excluding region, with eight codec-dependent skips; region requires an unavailable AV1 encoder in this build.
